name: Wholesale margin checker
why: Margin per unit after the retailer's cut, promos and freight, the first step of the wholesale terms skill.

name: Product margin checker
why: True margin per product from every cost, the number a partner fee or discount must be worked out from.

name: Landed cost calculator
why: Cost per sellable unit including freight, for imported lines before setting wholesale prices.

name: Franchise and reseller terms writer
why: A one-page term sheet with duties, fees and exits, like the partner deal summary for the lawyer.

name: Retail buyer approach planner
why: Plans how to win a larger retailer's buyer and keep the shelf, beyond independent shops.

name: Send reorder emails that fit each buyer, then read results
why: Timed reorder emails by buyer type and a read of results, matching the reorder and account plan skill.

name: Win-back flow builder
why: A win-back sequence timed to how buyers actually reorder, for slowing and lapsed accounts.

name: Trade show experiment planner
why: Plans a trade show as a measured test, a common way to meet new shops and distributors.

name: Direct selling model check
why: Compares selling direct with selling through channels by margin, before building a programme.

name: Build a developer partner program
why: A partner programme for software platforms with developer partners, alongside the programme design skill.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: Finds the deepest discount the margin allows, for checking reorder offers and partner discounts.
